evidence.quote: The World English Bible is in the Public Domain. That means that it is not copyrighted. However, "World English Bible" is a Trademark of eBible.org.
All we ask is that if you CHANGE the actual text of the World English Bible in any way, you not call the result the World English Bible any more.

attribution.text: World English Bible, public domain. "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org.

modifications: Converted from USFM to plain text, one entry per verse in KJV verse numbering. The words of the text are unaltered. Strong's numbers, footnotes and cross-reference notes are removed, and headings are kept. Romans 14:24-26, which this edition prints after Romans 14:23, is stored at Romans 16:25-27 where the KJV numbers it. Verses this edition leaves to footnotes, such as Luke 17:36, are marked as not in this translation.
